description: List the authenticated seller's FLUF products. Each row has a `vid` (the product handle that crosslist accepts), title, price, stock, source channel and the channels it is already live on. `status` is what the channel last reported to FLUF, not a live check, so an ended listing can still read 'active'. Each row's `liveness` ('confirmed' | 'unconfirmed' | 'unknown'), `last_seen_at` and `last_seen_age_hours` say when a channel scan last returned that listing. Filtering on `liveness: "confirmed"` narrows both the rows and `total` to listings a channel has recently confirmed; without it, `total` counts the seller's whole listing history. Two 'active' rows for the same item are usually one listing that ended and its relist, because channels issue a new listing id on relist.

crosslisted_to.description: Only products already live on these channels.

liveness.description: Filter by whether a channel has recently confirmed the listing still exists. 'confirmed' gives the seller's live catalogue, and it narrows `total` as well as the rows, which `status` does not.

not_on_platforms.description: Only products NOT yet on these channels — the usual way to find crosslist candidates.

source.description: Filter by the channel a product came FROM (e.g. 'shopify', 'depop'); list_channels returns the values valid on this account. Omit for all sources.

status.description: Listing status. Omit to get in-stock products only (a `search` with no status covers sold ones too). 'sold' = products FLUF holds as out of stock, i.e. sold on some channel; 'all' = in and out of stock. `status` is FLUF's record of what the channel last said, so a listing that has since ended still reads 'active'; each row's `liveness` field distinguishes live from stale.

name: list_products
